English Proficiency Policy
Minimum English Proficiency Test Requirements
Undergraduate
TOEFL iBT (reporting code 6872): 70
IELTS Academic: 6.0 (5.5 minimum in all bands)
Pearson Test of English (PTE): 48 (minimum of 44 in all skills)
Duolingo English Test (DET): 100 (minimum of 90 in all subscores)
GTEC CBT: 1175
Graduate
TOEFL iBT (reporting code 6872): 79
IELTS Academic: 6.5 (6.0 minimum in all bands)
PTE: 53
DET: 110
GTEC CBT: 1200
Exemptions
Citizens of a country that has English as an official language (PDF)
Students who have completed Composition I and II courses with a grade of C or better at a U.S.-accredited university or college
Students who have earned a degree or at least 24 credit hours of non-ESL coursework at an accredited university or college in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, New Zealand or Australia
Students who have successfully completed high school in the United States at an accredited school
Academic Program English Policies
Some academic programs have different English proficiency requirements. Review the details below for your desired program.
School of Science and Engineering
Computer Science, Data Science, Physics, Chemistry and Engineering Majors
English test exemptions: Master's and PhD students who earned a bachelor's or master's degree from an institution in Bangladesh, Egypt, India, Pakistan, Sri Lanka and Turkey are not required to submit proof of English proficiency for admission to these programs.

TOEFL iBT: 90
IELTS: 7.0 (6.5 minimum in all bands)
Duolingo English Test: 115
